title: THE RED PANDA HAS A SECRET GRIP FOR BAMBOO
caption: Red pandas have a built-in bamboo grip. 🐾🎋 #RedPanda #AnimalAnatomy #Wildlife #NatureFacts #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: Watch this red panda hold bamboo with a paw that almost looks like a hand.
narration_timeline.scene: Open on the real red panda eating bamboo and gripping a stem.

narration_timeline.text: High in the trees, bamboo makes up a major part of this animal's diet.
narration_timeline.scene: Establish a red panda on branches in a documented captive habitat.

narration_timeline.text: As it chews, its front paw keeps the stem close to its mouth.
narration_timeline.scene: Show the species handling bamboo; do not claim an unseen grip is visible.

narration_timeline.text: A modified wrist bone works like an extra thumb, helping it hold the stalk.
narration_timeline.scene: Show a real red panda feeding while explaining the hidden wrist structure.

narration_timeline.text: It isn't a real finger, but the trick makes feeding much easier.
narration_timeline.scene: Continue with authentic paw/feeding behavior, not a fake anatomical diagram.

narration_timeline.text: That small grip helps this tree climber turn tough bamboo into dinner.
narration_timeline.scene: Close on a red panda handling food; resolve the opening hand-like grip.
